name: The Lab Anti-Mall
description: The Lab Anti-Mall is an innovative open-air lifestyle center in Costa Mesa that redefines the traditional shopping experience with its eclectic mix of independent boutiques, vintage shops, and artisan eateries. This alternative retail destination features repurposed industrial architecture and a creative, urban aesthetic that attracts fashion-forward shoppers and trendsetters. With its commitment to local businesses and unique merchandise, The Lab offers a distinctive anti-establishment vibe that sets it apart from conventional shopping centers.
summary: An alternative open-air lifestyle center featuring independent boutiques, vintage shops, and artisan eateries with a creative urban aesthetic that celebrates non-mainstream retail culture.
